notes_for_editor: Build date and builder are unknown in every source read. Standing status rests on the Tennessee Landforms table and the 2014 extant list in the National Register study; no 2023 visit text beyond the NHLR date line was read. Access is set to private from the NHLR wording. A commercial land listing near Lutts (a 2018 listing of about 835 acres) was seen in search results but is not tied to this tower in any source, so it is not used.
